meta.text: The little girl opened the door, looked outside, and saw the first snowfall of the winter.

meta.text: Do you have fresh organic apples today? Where can I find the warm bakery section?

meta.title: Expressive Keyword Emphasis & Exclamation
meta.text: I really love the fresh hot chocolate, especially after playing in the cold snow all afternoon!

meta.title: Complete 22-Sentence Story Paragraph (1:1 Reference Benchmark)
meta.text: First Snowfall. Today is November 26th. It snowed all day today. The snow is beautiful. The snow finally stopped. My sister and I are excited. My mom doesn't like the snow. My mom has to shovel the driveway. My sister and I get to play. I put on my hat and mittens. My mom puts on my scarf. My mom zippers my jacket. My sister puts on her hat and mittens. My mom puts on her scarf. My mom zippers her jacket. My sister and I go outside. We begin to make a snowman. My mom starts to shovel the snow. My sister and I make snow angels. My sister and I throw snowballs. It starts to snow again. We go inside for hot chocolate.

meta.title: Multi-Turn Mother & Child Dialogue
meta.text: Good morning, sweetie! Did you see the yard outside? Wow, it is covered in bright white snow! Can we go outside and build a big snowman right now? Put on your warm scarf and mittens first, because the wind is very chilly. Okay, Mom! Come outside with us, and then we can drink hot chocolate together!

meta.title: Paragraph with Emotion Shifts (Excited -> Sympathetic/Tired -> Surprise -> Warm Cozy)
meta.text: My sister and I were so excited when we ran out into the bright white yard! Unfortunately, my mom was tired and worried because the icy driveway was hard to shovel. Suddenly, giant snowflakes began falling from the sky again! We went back inside, wrapped ourselves in warm blankets, and shared sweet hot chocolate together.
